notes.title: Third Wild Early Access Roadmap Revealed
notes.notes:
The Future of Third Wild
Third Wild is now a casual sandbox survival game, but that's not the end goal.

Third Wild vision is to be a game. Online survival with elements inspired by various genres such as sandbox survival MMO-RPG combines these systems such as level system, skill, and physical upgrades of the player character.

Below is a rough plan. For now, I can see the game progress in the future.

Things to keep in mind are things like adding items, new build parts Expanding the map, etc... happens all the time. Not just during the addition of the plans listed below.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42615260/7b90cb414d5c782a093b84ff5728343d9f5c183a.png[/img]

To gather your thoughts and feedback, I’ve created an official Third Wild Discord server. So if you want to stay close to the production process and share your thoughts, join me and the Third Wild community right here on [url=https://discord.gg/udsmne33pq]Discord[/url] I can’t wait to see you there!

If you want to support us you can do it on [url=https://www.patreon.com/thirdwildgame]patreon here[/url]
